highlight: Ultra-long-range. Engines enrolled on Rolls-Royce Corporate Care (RRCC), APU enrolled on MSP Gold.
overview:
This 2005 Global Express XRS is fully enrolled on Rolls-Royce Corporate Care, Smart Parts Plus, MSP Gold, and Collins CASP, with a major block of airframe and landing gear inspections completed in August 2025. She shows 8,842.7 hours and 4,672 landings, tracked on CAMP and operated Part 91.

The Honeywell Primus 2000XP flight deck features synthetic vision, HUD with EVS, and auto throttles, with FANS 1/A+, RNP-4, NAT HLA, RVSM, ADS-B Out, and increased MTOW. The 15-passenger cabin was refreshed in July 2020 and includes forward and aft lavatories, crew rest, and Starlink Wi-Fi.
